ops.text: For comparison, if NGTS-10 A dissipated tides as efficiently as the G dwarf TOI-8317, for which transit timing indicates $Q^{\prime}_{\star}=6.5\times 10^{5}$ [Fuenzalida et al., 2026], the constant-phase-lag relation [Patra et al., 2017] with $M_{\mathrm{p}}=2.16$ $M_{\mathrm{Jup}}$, $M_{\star}=0.70$ $M_{\odot}$ [McCormac et al., 2020] and $a/R_{\star}=4.71$ would give $\dot{P}\approx-2.6$ ms yr-1, or $P/|\dot{P}|\approx$ 25 Myr, a rate that our measurement cannot yet exclude.
